scenario: Valid bounded governance draft using supported evidence
rationale: Known-good output must remain accepted after future changes.

scenario: Observed pass rate 0.9958 compared with threshold 1.0
rationale: The system must deterministically identify 0.9958 as below 1.0 and classify the control as FAIL.

scenario: Draft invents an upstream source-system root cause
rationale: Unknown root causes must not be converted into asserted explanations.

scenario: Draft changes authoritative observed pass rate to 0.95
rationale: Generated numeric claims must correspond to authoritative evidence.

scenario: Draft expresses 0.9917 as the equivalent percentage 99.17%
rationale: Semantically equivalent numeric formatting must not create evaluator false positives.

scenario: Draft repeats the number 0 because it appears in the authoritative control rule
rationale: Numbers explicitly present in authoritative rule text must be accepted.

scenario: Draft changes authoritative High severity to Medium
rationale: The LLM must not overwrite deterministic severity.
AI-generated governance language must remain subject to human review.

scenario: Draft cites source_system_diagnosis as evidence even though the field is not allowed
rationale: The model must not claim evidence sources outside the bounded evidence contract.

scenario: Draft lists the same evidence field more than once
rationale: Evidence attribution should be unique and auditable.

scenario: LLM drafting evidence is built from the full governance evidence package
rationale: Only field, business_definition, business_process and downstream_use should be exposed to the LLM.

scenario: Generated business_context is reviewed for concepts not explicitly supported by bounded metadata
rationale: Machine validation cannot fully guarantee semantic grounding; a human reviewer checks that no new business consequences, causal mechanisms, reporting uses, liquidity effects or other unsupported concepts are introduced.
